description: ITSM helpdesk ticket orchestration: agent-driven ticket creation, Teams notification via Power Automate, and ticket status tracking. Composes existing rest and queue connectors for a common service-desk scenario.
notes: Service Bus connection strings are not supported. Managed identity only.
Teams webhook URL is the only unavoidable secret — store in Key Vault, not in environment variables.
The Foundry agent must be pre-registered with a File Search tool and create_ticket function tool.
Treat this file as contract metadata, not runtime executable configuration.
